title: D-1 intent v2 and installer API

filesChanged.change: MODIFIED: v2 schema with global + workspaces[canonical root] (resolveHarnessWorkspaceRoot); v1 servers map to retired on read, first write persists v2; missing/corrupt/unknown-version reads as empty, never global; atomicWriteWithRetry writes; record/listFor/forget/makeGlobal/scopeOf/listRetired; a workspace record without a root throws McpIntentScopeError. list() removed.
CREATED: 18 tests for roundtrip, workspace isolation, global merge, v1 retirement, corrupt/unknown-version empty reads, canonical key, makeGlobal, forget scopes.

MODIFIED: install() keeps its positional signature with a trailing optional scope defaulting to workspace; new makeGlobal(serverKey, workspaceRoot, homeTargets); uninstall() takes options.scope, and with no scope drops every record this workspace sees.
MODIFIED: record() calls use the v2 input object; new scoped intent suite (workspace isolation, global opt-in, makeGlobal, scoped uninstall).

crossOwnerEdits.change: readMcpIntents(workspaceRoot) calls listFor(workspaceRoot ?? '') instead of the removed list()
